discovery_sources: Benjamin Netanyahu official YouTube full Patriots interview; Ynet; Times of Israel; Reuters; ODNI; IAEA; CNN June 15 transcript
resolution_notes: Accepted as False / High confidence. Exact wording is preserved by independent reporting and the original full interview container. A June 15 CNN transcript additionally records Netanyahu saying Iran 'would already have atomic bombs' absent Israeli action, adding chronological context. Verdict remains limited to literal possession of assembled atomic bombs and origin remains Guest / interviewee.
